identity.standaloneProfile: AI Studio signed-permit bootstrap and optional standalone Lesson Hub server bearer session
identity.schoolProfile: same-origin school session enforcement remains deferred until an approved school runtime exists
identity.session: standalone bearer sessions are cleared before the configured server origin changes; browser-supplied roles never become future server authority

requestApiAi.controls: Lesson Hub has no provider AI request operation and no autonomous tool executor; introducing either requires inventory and policy review before admission.

egress.standalone: same-origin static assets plus the explicitly configured Lesson Hub server endpoint only
egress.school: same-origin school runtime only when that runtime is approved
egress.defaultDeny: provider AI egress and local provider credentials are not capabilities of Lesson Hub

files.currentBoundary: Local lesson/material imports remain browser-parsed and constrained by the existing import contracts, sanitization and size/type checks.
files.serverBoundary: Production upload quarantine and server filesystem isolation remain live-runtime controls and are not claimed by local CI.

dataLifecycle.storage: namespaced IndexedDB/local browser storage and optional Lesson Hub server persistence under existing suite-session and deletion rules
dataLifecycle.retention: user-controlled lesson/material lifecycle; shared-device cleanup and explicit deletion remain mandatory controls

release.promotion: candidate -> cumulative security gate -> pull request -> protected main -> exact release identity -> verified public Pages release -> app-updated
release.publicAssurance: TRANSITIONAL Pages release; school-server SHIELD-LIVE and runtime controls remain NOT_TESTED

inventory.changeRule: new egress, import class, privileged browser/server capability or release authority requires inventory update and matching negative tests

securityHealth.localCi: GARP 2.7 contract, architecture, mutation and release gates run with retained GARP 2.5.1/N5 regressions
securityHealth.live: NOT_TESTED until an approved target runtime supplies trusted runtime evidence
securityHealth.failureMode: missing, stale, mismatched or empty evidence never becomes PASS

incident.current: bounded error reporting, release evidence and fail-closed promotion remain active; diagnostic content is minimized
incident.future: central runtime monitoring and infrastructure containment require separate server approval

recovery.current: Safe Promotion, exact release identity, rollback-aware release integrity and local data export/deletion form the current recovery baseline
recovery.future: server restore, trust-root custody and live recovery drills remain NOT_TESTED until the school runtime is approved
